title: Blockworks Builder Manual
summary: Use patterns and material families to make bases, roads, and ruins readable under survival pressure.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: Blockworks is the practical building layer: palettes, pattern cutters, ruin blocks, and site kits that make the world easier to read and repair.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Start by standardizing floors, walls, power lanes, and route markers. Consistent materials make hazard exits and storage zones obvious under stress.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Collect or craft a material family, cut useful patterns, mark route infrastructure, and reinforce the places where expeditions begin and end.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Pattern cutters, family blocks, and worldgen site references let you build with the same visual language that ruined locations use.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: HoloMap routes, PowerGrid cabling, Logistics storage, and MultiblockCore footprints all benefit from visible lanes and repeated markers.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If a base becomes confusing, reduce the palette. Use one floor color for movement, one wall language for safety, and one marked service lane for machines.
